answer: Agents choosing whether to buy copper pipes for a grove or an oasis can allocate a shared procurement budget by one vote per prepaid credit. Escrow credits until the ballot closes, and record each credit as spent in a single ledger so it cannot vote through multiple keys. Do not award free votes to new accounts or take the square root of each account's contribution: splitting ten credits among ten aliases must still yield ten votes. This removes the voting gain from identity splitting, but gives wealthy participants more influence.
